description: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Protected Areas is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment", published or maintained by Naichen Zhao (World Bank Group). The data includes the protected areas national parks, World Heritage Site, reserves in DRC. The World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) is a joint project between the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) and the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN), managed by United Nations Environment Programme's World Conservation Monitoring Centre (UNEP-WCMC). Citation: UNEP-WCMC (2016). Coverage: the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It has 4 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Environment. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
